Description
This 2015 Mercedes Benz A Class A220 CDI AMG Night Edition is a prime example of sophisticated engineering and thoughtful ownership. Benefiting from a Euro 6 emission class, this 2.1L diesel engine offers an efficient yet powerful driving experience. The AMG Night Edition trim level ensures a distinctive presence, complemented by desirable features such as Bi-Xenon headlights with automatic activation, and a convenient rear camera that includes parking assistance. Stay connected on the go with integrated Bluetooth, and enjoy a comfortable cabin environment thanks to the efficient air conditioning system.The performance of this A Class is noteworthy, achieving 0-62mph in just 8.2 seconds, demonstrating its brisk acceleration which sets it apart from many comparable vehicles. Beyond its dynamic capabilities, this model boasts a notably large boot space, offering practical versatility for everyday needs and longer journeys. These combined attributes, from its responsive engine and advanced lighting to its generous storage and swift acceleration, highlight how this Mercedes Benz A Class provides a superior driving proposition.-STUNNING CAR!!!-AA approved dealer / 12 mths free AA cover
